name: Kagami Hare
source:
"Seira, show me some more of that shyness of yours. I'll do the same for you. Sound good…?"

Height: Tall
Figure: Reasonable
Appearance: Frank
Special Skills: Cramming overnight before tests, taming animals, sports in general (specifically ball game ones)

Cheerful, sociable, and having lots of friends, Hare is the student council president. Seen as candid and reliable, she's good at dealing with things and is at the ready when called on.

Although attracted by [url=https://vndb.org/c39149]Seira[/url], who progresses forward and faces things head on, Hare does worry about her, but thanks to the time she's spent with Seira, they both were able to throw their feelings at each other, making their true intentions heard.

Hare does the big jobs of the student council (and lets Seira handle the minor stuff).

Featured in Drama CD Vol. 5 "Zawameki, Tokimeki, Yappa Suki" (lit. Commotion, Throbbing, Love Nevertheless)

[Translated from [url=http://www.particle.jp.net/lilycle_rs/chara05.html]Official Site[/url]]
